name: Fast LRU Cache with TTL Expiry
problem_statement: Implement an LRU Cache with Time-To-Live (TTL) expiration per entry. Key-value pairs should expire after ttl_seconds. Reading an unexpired key marks it as most recently used. Evict least recently used items when capacity is reached.
unit_tests:
def test_lru_ttl_scenario():
    cache = LruCacheTTL(capacity=2, default_ttl=0.2)
    cache.set('a', 1)
    cache.set('b', 2)
    assert cache.get('a') == 1
    cache.set('c', 3)  # Evicts 'b' because 'a' was accessed
    assert cache.get('b') is None
    assert cache.get('a') == 1
    assert cache.get('c') == 3
    time.sleep(0.25)
    assert cache.get('a') is None
    assert len(cache) == 1 or len(cache) == 0
